svg.aria-label: Group commit: an fsync takes about the same time whether it flushes one transaction or a hundred, so the database collects commits that arrive while a flush is running and makes them durable together with one fsync, multiplying commit throughput.
svg.title: Group commit: an fsync takes about the same time whether it flushes one transaction or a hundred, so the database collects commits that arrive while a flush is running and makes them durable together with one fsync, multiplying commit throughput.
svg.text: One fsync per commit caps a single writer at ~1k–10k commits/s; batching amortises it across many.
